mapper.sql: EXECUTION_ID, JOB_ID, JOB_CODE, OCCURRENCE_KEY, TRIGGER_TYPE, SCHEDULED_TIME, STATE, ATTEMPT, EXECUTOR_INSTANCE, LEASE_UNTIL, NEXT_RETRY_TIME, START_TIME, FINISH_TIME, DURATION_MS, TRACE_ID, ERROR_TYPE, ERROR_MESSAGE, VERSION, CREATED_TIME, MODIFY_TIME
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO PEACH_SCHEDULER_EXECUTION (EXECUTION_ID, JOB_ID, JOB_CODE, OCCURRENCE_KEY, TRIGGER_TYPE, SCHEDULED_TIME, STATE, ATTEMPT, TRACE_ID, VERSION, CREATED_TIME, MODIFY_TIME) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{jobId}, #{jobCode}, #{occurrenceKey}, #{triggerType}, #{scheduledTime}, #{state}, #{attempt}, #{traceId}, #{version}, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE PEACH_SCHEDULER_EXECUTION SET STATE = #{toState}, ERROR_TYPE = #{errorType}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, MODIFY_TIME = NOW(3) WHERE EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND STATE = #{fromState} AND VERSION = #{version}

UPDATE PEACH_SCHEDULER_EXECUTION SET STATE = 'RUNNING', EXECUTOR_INSTANCE = #{executorInstance}, LEASE_UNTIL = #{leaseUntil}, START_TIME = NOW(3), FINISH_TIME = NULL, DURATION_MS = NULL, VERSION = VERSION + 1, MODIFY_TIME = NOW(3) WHERE EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND STATE = 'QUEUED' AND VERSION = #{version}

UPDATE PEACH_SCHEDULER_EXECUTION SET STATE = 'RETRY_WAIT', LEASE_UNTIL = NULL, NEXT_RETRY_TIME = #{nextRetryTime}, FINISH_TIME = NOW(3), ERROR_TYPE = #{errorType}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, VERSION = VERSION + 1, MODIFY_TIME = NOW(3) WHERE EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND STATE = 'RUNNING' AND VERSION = #{version}

UPDATE PEACH_SCHEDULER_EXECUTION SET STATE = 'QUEUED', ATTEMPT = ATTEMPT + 1, EXECUTOR_INSTANCE = NULL, LEASE_UNTIL = NULL, NEXT_RETRY_TIME = NULL, START_TIME = NULL, FINISH_TIME = NULL, DURATION_MS = NULL, VERSION = VERSION + 1, MODIFY_TIME = NOW(3) WHERE EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND STATE = 'RETRY_WAIT' AND VERSION = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PEACH_SCHEDULER_EXECUTION WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobId} AND STATE IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_WAIT')
